nodes.label: Discipline
nodes.name: Platform Engineering
nodes.description: Discipline of designing and building toolchains and workflows that enable self-service capabilities for software engineering organizations.

nodes.label: System
nodes.name: Internal Developer Platform (IDP)
nodes.description: Unified layer of tools and infrastructure that reduces developer cognitive load across engineering teams.

nodes.label: Pattern
nodes.name: Paved Roads (Golden Paths)
nodes.description: Standardized, recommended Golden Paths and templates to accelerate development with built-in security.

nodes.label: Principle
nodes.name: Self-Service
nodes.description: Team autonomy to provision and operate services without manual inter-departmental ticket queues.

nodes.label: Principle
nodes.name: Platform as a Product
nodes.description: Managing internal platforms as products with developer user feedback, adoption metrics, and continuous iteration.

nodes.label: Methodology
nodes.name: Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
nodes.description: Alignment of platform boundaries and service APIs with bounded business domains.

nodes.label: Architecture
nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.description: Autonomous LLM-driven architecture capable of reasoning, planning, and executing tools.

nodes.label: Pattern
nodes.name: ReAct Pattern
nodes.description: Interactive Reasoning and Action (Thought, Action, Observation) loop for complex problem-solving.

nodes.label: Framework
nodes.name: LangGraph
nodes.description: Orchestration framework for building stateful, multi-agent cyclical workflows using directed graphs.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.name: Tools & Function Calling
nodes.description: Model capability to trigger typed function executions and interact with external systems.

nodes.label: Tool
nodes.name: LangSmith
nodes.description: Observability, debugging, and tracing platform for agent execution runs.

nodes.label: Architecture
nodes.name: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
nodes.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture combining external vector/lexical retrieval with LLM generation.

nodes.label: Methodology
nodes.name: Fine-Tuning
nodes.description: Supervised adaptation of pre-trained model weights to specialized domains, styles, or tasks.

nodes.label: Technique
nodes.name: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
nodes.description: Low-Rank Adaptation technique (PEFT) freezing base weights and training small rank-decomposition matrices.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.name: Vector Store (ChromaDB)
nodes.description: High-dimensional text embedding storage enabling semantic similarity search.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.name: Reranker (Cross-Encoder)
nodes.description: Secondary neural cross-encoder scoring query-document attention to reorder retrieved candidates.
